practical_insight: Emotional and external storms are transient. Cultivate Titiksha (forbearance) to remain centered through life cycles.

translation_en: You have a right to perform your prescribed duty, but you are not entitled to the fruits of action. Never consider yourself the cause of results, and never be attached to inaction.
practical_insight: Total focus on the execution of work without outcome-anxiety creates peak creative mastery (Flow state).

siddhyasiddhyoḥ samo bhūtvā samatvaṁ yoga ucyate

translation_en: Perform your duty equipoised, O Arjuna, abandoning all attachment to success or failure. Such equanimity of mind is called Yoga.
practical_insight: Equanimity in success and failure is the true definition of Yoga.
